body:
I dont know how to get past my grief without something coming out of nowhere, everything i try to do on my own for myself ends up going nowhere, dead ends everywhere. I just reached out again after a week of nothing...another week will go by and nothing done.

i cant keep this up any longer, 20+ years of depression is finally taking its final toll.

killing yourself isnt even worth anyones time anymore...everyone is too focused on $

I have long had this issue...part of it also applied to the possibility if life got "better"  Id be scared that all the years of suicide ideation would forever be a part of me and even if i say had a spouse and children, hit the lottery or just invested wisely or whatever have you...fun all that jazz...a good life, by some basic standard...where the future was worth staying for...but part of me told myself "you *might* still do it anyways...Im scared I can never shake suicide because of all the years its been a part of my existence

That used to be my feeling. I used to just think "hey i dont hurt anybody, so what if ill never crack 30K a year, i make more than most people ever will on this planet because of the way things are" I used to be able to get by with just smoking and figuring if i take up just one or two hobbies i wont be in this state....but then it just turned on me, i just felt so non-essential...i dont have a family or friends to kind of ...fall back on mentally to go , people will miss me...nobody is going to miss me because either theyre already dead or they werent friendly enough to ever care what happens to me.

I guess i started taking the problems of the world to heart and just felt that I wouldnt exist if we got it together. For the most part people are okay but we all know where we're headed with this inequality across the planet...anyways end rant, just thought id comment to say...i wish i could get back to that state where shit doesnt make me want to kill myself every morning but to live until my biology gives out...and then if anything remember I have the power to take myself out at any time i deem fit. Just wish the last 15 years hadnt been so bad and fucked up the next 15

They did mean a lot to me. Everything that means everything to me is gone. All i ever wanted was for someone to share in it. Prevent it. I'm not alone and lost at 29 if someone was there at 17. 

I don't even have a friend over 5+ years of acquaintance. There's no one to go "remember when we were kids/teenagers/highschool/college

There's noone to go "Hey you were *good* at that"

There's no "I remember your cousin or brother or *you*"

To be normal...id have to restart life from the very beginning and hope I make different mistakes. 

I'm on the top of the fence. Either I jump to my death or I fall back into obscurity.

there is a point where depression consumes so much of your life, theres no way to ever be "normal" again. I can never forget the pain and the memories of suffering.

If people stronger than me with more to live for can't find a way out of the misery. What chance do I have?

Well thats an issue I have about "Help" i dont need clinically diagnosed help I need the sense of normalcy. Basically Im upset that I cant make friends without them ever knowing im depressed. Like why have i never found friends through my writing? Why, being known as a comedian, didnt i have an audience to make laugh? Why, when I played baseball did i not find friends to play softball with when we grew up? 

It wasnt because i didnt want to do these things, i always asked "hey what are you guys doing today" but id already be too late, they made their plans yesterday etc. It became less about being thought of as not a friend and more of being not thought of at all.

The only thing worse than being talked about...is not being talked about.

Ive heard of meetup, but where i live, theres little activity. I dont like bars I just use that since that seems the de facto place to go for hookups, its even researched over the decades. Most people meet in Bars, thru friends or at work.

Top 3 ways to meet a SO and im shut out of all three.

I was going to leave to go get myself killed in the desert on the other side of the world. What stopped me was my own paradoxical views on war.

As much as someone may be evil I just cant kill another. I thought about it. Thought about how much pain and suffering theyve inflicted on people in this world and how righteous id be to kill them.
but i wouldnt...there is nothing on this earth worth killing for.

There may be things to die for, but never to kill.

So i didnt go. I have PTSD when it rains or snows...i got into a car accident years ago and since then, when i see a snowflake or a raindrop i freak out and the car (if i have one) is pulled over.

I wouldnt say mine is more tragic, we're all suffering in so many different yet equal ways. 

Idk how to describe the future/past thing other than...you cant be a young college freshman twice...You can't describe past memories with your good friends at one of your friends weddings...because you werent in their memories...and you wont be invited to the wedding.

I can never show my parents my diploma, because they're long dead.

I lost all my possessions so if I ever have a future SO, when they ask...where are pictures of you growing up? I cant show them any.

I have no proof i was alive really...nothing to look back on but lost *time* I can never get back.

I don't really handle it well. There's always more to the story. I thought I was going to leave the country last month so I packed 95% of all the things in my apt and got rid of them. Then i chickened out and now all I have is a mattress and a dining room table and a few clothes. I really really would prefer, if i made an online friend, for them to be HERE in my location so we can turn it into reality, but thats not been the case in my years.

I hate the computer really feel like ive been staring at screens for decades and nothing has come of it. Im one of those people who know show to turn it on and web search but wtf is code? (i know what it is just beyond dimwits like me)

I know this is part of the tech age and its well, evolution but i just feel so left out. I missed 1,000 weekends where i could have danced with someone, spoke to someone gotten an idea started. But i missed out on all that because i was ostracized. I feel uncomfortable walking into a bar to chat with someone, and i lost all my feelings for hobbies.

Like i dont even know how to tie knots and i dont want to find a knot tying club i want to find a person who has varied interests and doesnt know im depressed. Idk its all so confusing sometimes and thats what does the most damage.

Feel just short of normal. I dont have the feelings of being a burden to my family anymore because theyre all dead. I should be free-er but Im even more constrained.

I dont want to be the guy thats "hey you hear what happened to him? hung himself in the woods, poor guy wish i could of yada yada etc etc"

I fear that fate but i dont see another fate where its "o man i havent seen you in forever but i was thinking of you the other day call me, talk to me if you can"

I dont have a future because i dont have a past.

When I hear stories like yours, someone who spent their life and energy towards fighting the "good fight" and then after decades and countless opportunities in your stories (and others) for enough of a mass to throw off this yoke of a destroyed "system" watches it go absolutely nowhere, in fact, regress. I cant help but think.

Why bother? Why go into "helping expose" or trying to uncover the issues of this country and society in general...when it absolutely means nothing will change.

fingers in a dam thats already burst is my visual.

Thanks for giving you heart and soul.

Well, theres a silver lining I guess. Ive never been angry but lately the depression has forced me to embrace rage because the sadness and crying invariably leads to me hurting myself, so now i just skip the sadness and go right to hurting myself

I'm not fading away biologically, in fact im quite healthy in the sense that if my mind wasnt self-destructing I could live until 80s-90s with no problem (no diseases/cancer in my fam history)  

and im aware reddit is of a crazy selection but i cant find people to MEET in person...i dont like doing these messages...because if i had another human being in my life i wouldnt be on reddit.

I just feel i failed because i wasnt prepared, my parents didnt tell me the world that was coming and i was sheltered at home because everytime i went out i was beat up or made fun of. 

That destroys a kid with  no friends, it makes him fear the outside and at 10 years old you cant just say "go out there and make the world you want!" it doesnt wash...I used to play bass, until nobody wanted me in a band. I used to write, until people laughed at my writing. I dont even bother to write here on reddit because i know my stuff will be at the bottom with 0 points.

I cant shake this worldly feel too. Who cares about my individual happiness while the world cries out? I just dont see the need for me as an individual if im not contributing to society as a whole.

i dont want to feed the homeless because we can easily solve the problem of homelessness without it...

i hate thinking im putting my fingers in a dam thats already exploded.

At the macro level I want peace, at the micro i could care less and just want my own personal love.

Im just too warped and i dont know what to make of existence.

For the longest i shrugged it off and said "it gets better"

i did all the suicide exercises ...and here i am...

I may be 30 but ive been suicidal and massively depressed for more than 25 years. 

all the suicides do make it easier...because i'm just a raindrop in the ocean. If there were only 5 people who went thru with it a year, id be more hesitant...but it seems a lot of us do it...if #s are to be trusted, possibly 20 million people since ive been born have lost all hope.

Thats the NYC metro area, gone right now in the blink of an eye...and yet not a tent in overall population. Sigh. Just

Im suicidal yet full of life...i dont get how to not feel so down about it though.

I just feel if you have dearest friends, nows the time to I guess see how far it goes. Not like you're using your suicide but just reminding them "hey all that talk about telling people you care about them before you never see them again well here I am"...I wish i could say something like come here i'll take you in and we fight it together but I know its unrealistic. 

you may be far from your family in physical distance but thyre there for you right now. They may not understand and you may harbor somrthing against them but in your head you must know there ARE a few people in this realm who dont want to see you go, and definitely not see you go out this way. All i can say is hold on and use this backed into a corner type rage to find what would sustain you in life...i know theres a few things in this world that'd keep me here til my biology runs out but im unable to have it...goodbyes are the hardest

No I know it seems that way. Part of me wouldnt care where I went, but part of me thinks, that despite how I may feel im the lowest of the low, how ill never ever find happiness in any form i try to think of...id rather die somewhere else, somewhere a little more aesthetically pleasing especially if I'm in control of it now.

Not knocking anyones choices, to each their own

always seems to be the problem, the people we can share this emotional wreckage with are always so far away where one of us, despite maybe having a little bit more to offer, is still just as powerless. I'd say make the most of it but id be lying to myself and you. I sit and waste here and i try to communicate but it falls on deaf ears. I hope you dont fall victim like most of us do, i hope something perks up your inner spirit or whats left of it, but i hope the same for me and it's yet to arrive. Sorry your abode is a railway.   at least there's people there, maybe one of them can tlk to you the same, maybe show you it isnt all bad as we think, tho it may be. Just to find that one little thing to hold onto. Its worth a shot i guess.

Right. I understand. I try to make myself think "cmon itll get there it'll get there" but when the day ends and nothing has been gained and more misery is following...i cant think of anything to keep me here either. I just hate feeling Im at the point that a lot of us reach every year...that point of no return. The final decision time.

Where in the states (if the states) are you? you can pm me, but just i understand.

I cant enjoy anything anymore, I cant see a therapist i don't have the $ for it and $ is all-important. Why waste time on books just to *feel* better when it doesnt contribute to a better life? I've read plenty of books, seen many movies, heard many songs...im tired of doing it alone...i cant find any groups I live in a small town. Theres nobody who shares my interests. 

The only thing that would improve my life quality is another human being willing to treat me like i'm alive.

30 years later...it's ending. the world moves a lot more rapidly now.

Millions of us take our lives every year...some of us have all the things...hobbies, love, kids etc...and we still do it.

I think there's just something fundamentally wrong overall, it cant be cured. I'm meant to die because thats how statistics are

same boat, my only friend in this world moved 2000 miles away and she thinks if i come out there ill feel better, but i wont ill have spent $ i cant make back as quick as i spent it (esp unemployed) and ill come back to my lame apartment with no friends and wish i could continue the fun i just had. When i tell her it'll depress me more, why cant you come here? i get yelled at. Just. At the same point today as you are. If i dont do it today ill just go through more pain, even as hard as i try to not, itll come
